title: Away and Back
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：away　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 away 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Away, in 1958 the guide carried the map at the ledge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: the guide had carried the map ② away before dawn, and nobody had asked a single question. The guide had come to the valley two days earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The guidebook for July 1952 puts it plainer. The map was ③ away, and the traveller who kept it wrote of the map ④ away in the same line; nothing in the valley was ever left away for long in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ away, and ⑥ Away came the traveller who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was that the map be found ⑦ away at the ledge, and that everybody be ⑧ away before the July rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried away.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968 she carried the map ⑨ away in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Away, she said in 1970, that was the part the valley never forgot; the guidebook still speaks of it away. She kept the map in the same ledge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how away it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 离开（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the map away，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 离开（作表语，说明处所或去向：the map was away）
C. adv. 在远处（置于句首：Away, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在远处（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the map away）
E. adv. 在远处（作介词宾语：from away）
F. adv. 在远处（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Away came the traveller）
G. adv. 离开（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be found away at the ledge）
H. adv. 离开（be away 说明所在或去向：everybody be away before the rains）

answers.why: away 意为“在远处”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Away, in 1958 …。
away 意为“离开”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the map away。
away 意为“离开”，此处作表语说明那件小小的地图的去向或所在：was away。
away 意为“在远处”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the map away。
away 意为“在远处”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from away。
away 意为“在远处”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Away came the traveller。
away 意为“离开”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be found away at the ledge。
away 意为“离开”，be away 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
away 意为“离开”，1968 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬走那件小小的地图，副词置于句末。
away 意为“在远处”，母亲 1970 年那句话以地点状语开头：Away, …。

那件小小的地图当时就在离开。（was away）

叔叔是从离开回来的。（from away）
记录要求那件小小的地图在崖台被找离开。（be found away）
